name: OpenUSD
role: Compose scenes and exchange time-sampled results; not a solver
dependency_notes: Custom result attributes need an agreed schema; preserve native solver inputs.

name: Blender
role: Create and inspect geometry; render simulation outputs
dependency_notes: Scene authoring and rendering do not establish physical validity.

name: Isaac Sim
role: Robot dynamics; sensors; synthetic scenes
license_summary: Apache-2.0 source; additional runtime and asset terms
dependency_notes: Omniverse Kit and assets have separate NVIDIA terms; suitable NVIDIA GPU required for the documented workflow.

name: Isaac Lab
role: Robot-learning environments and parallel training
dependency_notes: The walkthrough pins v2.2.0 with Isaac Sim 5.0.0; current main has changed. GPU runtime and assets have separate terms.

name: MuJoCo
role: Articulated-body dynamics and contact
dependency_notes: CPU core; rendering and accelerated backends have additional requirements.

name: Gazebo
role: Robot worlds; sensors; systems integration
dependency_notes: Current Gazebo differs from the historical Gazebo in the 2004 paper; pin simulator and plugins together.

name: Webots
role: Robot simulation with ready-made worlds and controllers
dependency_notes: Check the individual robot and scene asset licenses.

name: Bullet / PyBullet
role: Rigid-body dynamics; collision; Python robotics environments
dependency_notes: Robot models and third-party examples carry separate terms.

name: Project Chrono
role: Multibody dynamics; contact; vehicle and granular systems
dependency_notes: Choose modules and dependencies for the intended model; some workflows need substantial compute.

name: SOFA
role: Deformable-body and interactive multiphysics simulation
dependency_notes: Use for nonclinical computational studies here; plugin and material models need their own checks.

name: Drake
role: Robot dynamics; control; optimization and system analysis
dependency_notes: Some optional optimization backends are proprietary; use an open backend when required.

name: BlenderProc
role: Generate synthetic images with labeled scene data
dependency_notes: Rendering pipeline; external meshes and textures need separate rights checks.

name: CARLA
role: Autonomous-driving worlds; sensors and traffic agents
dependency_notes: MIT source does not cover the entire Unreal Engine runtime or every asset.

name: OpenFOAM (Foundation)
role: Finite-volume CFD and related continuum solvers
dependency_notes: Foundation and OpenCFD releases are different distributions; adapters must match the selected distribution.

name: SU2
role: Aerodynamics; CFD; adjoint design optimization
dependency_notes: Mesh and boundary-condition checks are required before interpreting forces.

name: preCICE
role: Couple separate solvers across meshes and time steps
dependency_notes: Coupling library; requires compatible native solvers and adapters.

name: FEniCSx / DOLFINx
role: Finite-element PDE models in Python and C++
dependency_notes: Keep variational equations; boundary conditions; mesh and solver configuration.

name: deal.II
role: Finite-element framework with adaptive meshes
license_summary: Apache-2.0 with LLVM exception OR LGPL-2.1-or-later
dependency_notes: Tutorial examples can have their own notices; the FSI3 guide requires the nonlinear adapter solver.

name: MFEM
role: High-order finite-element discretization and solvers
dependency_notes: CPU and accelerator support depends on the chosen build and backend.

name: MOOSE
role: Build coupled finite-element and finite-volume applications
dependency_notes: Framework and downstream applications can have different licenses and data requirements.

name: Elmer FEM
role: Structural; thermal; electromagnetic and fluid PDE models
dependency_notes: Inspect component notices and the selected solver manual.

name: CalculiX
role: Structural and thermal finite-element analysis
dependency_notes: Keep native input decks and constitutive-model assumptions; pre/postprocessor is a separate component.

name: OpenModelica
role: Equation-based dynamic systems and Modelica models
license_summary: AGPL-3.0 option; OSMC alternatives; separate runtime terms
dependency_notes: Modelica libraries and FMUs have their own terms and dependencies.

name: PyBaMM
role: Electrochemical battery models and discharge protocols
dependency_notes: CPU example included; parameter sets apply to particular cells and conditions.

name: openEMS
role: Electromagnetic fields with finite-difference time-domain methods
dependency_notes: Requires geometry and a mesh; check excitation; absorbing boundaries and convergence.

name: ngspice
role: Analog and mixed-signal circuit simulation
dependency_notes: Linked GitHub source is a mirror; upstream is SourceForge. Device models may have separate restrictions.

name: Cantera
role: Chemical kinetics; reacting flows and transport
dependency_notes: Reaction-mechanism files and their validity ranges matter independently of software licensing.

name: LAMMPS
role: Particle and molecular dynamics across scales
dependency_notes: Select potential files and units explicitly; accelerator packages are optional.

name: DualSPHysics
role: Particle-based free-surface flow and fluid-body interaction
dependency_notes: CPU or CUDA builds; runtime depends strongly on particle count and duration. The case generator GenCase is a separately licensed binary-only helper; the example retrieves it and preserves its own terms.

name: QuantLib
role: Derivative pricing; stochastic processes and Monte Carlo
dependency_notes: Synthetic example needs no market-data subscription; real curves and prices have separate terms.

name: ABIDES
role: Agent-based limit-order-book market simulation
dependency_notes: Original repository uses an old Python stack. The separate JPMorgan ABIDES-Gym repository is archived as checked 2026-11-15.

name: FinRL
role: Financial reinforcement-learning environments and backtests
dependency_notes: Training and backtesting platform; historical data access and out-of-sample evaluation are separate tasks.

name: Open Source Risk Engine
role: Portfolio scenarios; exposure and risk calculations
dependency_notes: QuantLib-based; use bundled example markets before connecting licensed market data.

name: HARK / Econ-ARK
role: Heterogeneous-household choice and simulation
dependency_notes: Current HARK example differs from the historical REMARK environment; see the authors' reproduction route.

name: QuantEcon.py
role: Markov chains; dynamic programming and economic computation
dependency_notes: Supporting numerical library and lectures; choose and identify a specific economic model.

name: OG-Core
role: Overlapping-generations equilibrium and fiscal-policy models
dependency_notes: CC0 dedication; country calibrations and tax functions are separate inputs.

name: Tax-Calculator
role: U.S. income and payroll-tax microsimulation
dependency_notes: Use allowed public-use inputs; code access does not supply restricted tax records or establish current-law accuracy.

name: OpenFisca
role: Tax-benefit microsimulation from rules and household inputs
dependency_notes: Core engine; install the appropriate country package and pin the legislation period.

name: Mesa
role: Python agent-based models and batch experiments
dependency_notes: Software paper verified; a specific published application still needs selection.

name: Agents.jl
role: Agent-based modeling in Julia
dependency_notes: Julia environment; preserve agent activation and random-number settings.

name: NetLogo
role: Interactive agent-based models and experiment sweeps
dependency_notes: Engine license does not cover every Models Library entry. ViNoS requires its own archived model.

name: GAMA
role: Spatial agent-based models with geographic inputs
dependency_notes: GIS inputs and scenario models have separate terms.

name: Ciw
role: Queueing-network discrete-event simulation
dependency_notes: CPU; arrival; service; blocking and queue disciplines must match the research model.

name: simmer
role: Trajectory-based discrete-event simulation in R
dependency_notes: Keep R package versions and replication seeds.

name: PyPSA
role: Power flow; dispatch and energy-system optimization
dependency_notes: Current core is MIT; historical releases used GPL. Use an open solver such as HiGHS when needed.

name: pandapower
role: Power flow; short circuits and network analysis
dependency_notes: Some optional optimization engines have separate licenses; verify network input data.

name: Calliope
role: Energy-system planning and optimization
dependency_notes: Optimization model; open and commercial solver backends are distinct choices.

name: SUMO
role: Microscopic multimodal traffic simulation
dependency_notes: LuST's published validation used SUMO 0.26; a modern port requires a new comparison.

name: MATSim
role: Large-scale agent-based transport demand and mobility
dependency_notes: Java; population and transport-network inputs have separate access and licensing.

name: WNTR
role: Water-network hydraulics; failures and resilience
dependency_notes: Depends on EPANET and other separately licensed components; network data may be sensitive.

name: EnergyPlus
role: Building energy; HVAC and water-use simulation
license_summary: BSD-style EnergyPlus license with naming clause
dependency_notes: Weather files and building descriptions are separate inputs; check design-day and annual-run settings.

name: WRF
role: Numerical weather and atmospheric simulation
dependency_notes: HPC commonly needed; forcing data; preprocessing and parameterizations are separate dependencies.

name: OpenDrift
role: Lagrangian ocean; atmosphere and particle trajectories
dependency_notes: Forecast/reanalysis forcing data can need accounts and can change independently of the code.

name: COPASI
role: Biochemical reaction networks; deterministic and stochastic models
dependency_notes: Use published model files and kinetic parameters; no clinical inference from model execution.

name: Tellurium
role: Reproducible systems-biology models and simulation experiments
dependency_notes: SBML; SED-ML and COMBINE workflows; third-party solvers and model licenses remain separate.

name: Brian 2
role: Spiking neural-network simulation
dependency_notes: Equation-based models; compilation backend and units need explicit selection.

name: ns-3
role: Packet-level network simulation
dependency_notes: GitHub is an upstream-maintained mirror; primary development is on GitLab.

name: SimGrid
role: Distributed-computing and scheduling simulation
dependency_notes: GitHub mirror; simulation platform files need calibration against the hardware being modeled.

name: SimPy
role: Process-based discrete-event simulation in Python
dependency_notes: CPU; service-system models must preserve warm-up; replications and random streams.

name: Dynare
role: Dynamic stochastic general equilibrium and related macroeconomic models
license_summary: GPL-3.0-or-later for most source; component notices
dependency_notes: Use GNU Octave for an open runtime; MATLAB is an optional proprietary alternative. Pin .mod file and calibration.
